TFCE with Permutation FWER

Source: R/tfce.R
tfce_fwer.Rd

Computes TFCE with permutation-based FWER control using the maxT procedure. The null distribution is supplied via a null_spec; for subject-level inference build one with null_one_sample() / null_two_sample() / null_glm(). For a fast voxel-level fallback use null_voxel_signflip() (note: voxel sign-flips are calibrated only when the field is uncorrelated under the null).

Usage

tfce_fwer(
  stat_vol,
  mask = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  tail = c("pos", "neg", "two"),
  H = 2,
  E = 0.5,
  dh = 0.1,
  null_spec = NULL,
  null_fun = NULL,
  n_perm = NULL,
  allow_voxel_signflip = FALSE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

stat_vol

3D Z-equivalent statistic map.

mask

Optional logical 3D mask.

alpha

Significance level (default 0.05).

tail

One of "pos", "neg", "two".

H

Height exponent (default 2.0).

E

Extent exponent (default 0.5).

dh

Threshold increment (default 0.1).

null_spec

A null_spec supplying n_perm deterministic null draws.

null_fun

Optional function function(b) returning a null draw for permutation b. Kept for compatibility with the package's older permutation API; prefer null_spec for new code.

n_perm

Number of permutations to consume from null_spec. Defaults to null_spec$n_perm.

allow_voxel_signflip

Logical; if TRUE, allows a fallback to independent voxel sign-flips when neither null_spec nor null_fun is supplied. This fallback is fast but can be anti-conservative for spatially correlated fields.

seed

Optional random seed; affects only RNG state outside null_spec (the spec itself is deterministic by index).

Value

A neurothresh_result with method = "tfce_fwer". pvals is the voxelwise FWER-corrected p-value volume; extras$tfce holds the observed TFCE map; null_max is the vector of per-permutation max-TFCE values.

See also

tfce_transform(), null_voxel_signflip(), null_one_sample().
